grh_81969d0e899a81c8b0d9.title: They Left the Back Door Open
paragraphs: John Donaldson recounts the life of his brother Bill, a working-class Canadian whose belief in British ideals collapses when he sees injustice and indifference toward fascism. Bill deserts the British Army, goes to Spain to fight with the International Brigades and earns the loyalty of the people around him through courage and good humor. During the Republican collapse, he volunteers for a diversionary attack so others can escape. Armed only with a club and a few grenades among his men, Bill is last seen charging a machine-gun position and dies helping open the way to safety.
